```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"No healthcare professional or organization should be required to perform, provide for, withhold, or refer for a medical service against their conscience.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This applies especially to religious organizations which deliver a major portion of America's healthcare, a service rooted in the charity of faith communities.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Healthcare providers should not be allowed to withhold services because the healthcare provider believes the patient's life is not worth living.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All organizations should have the ability to provide, purchase, or enroll in healthcare coverage consistent with their religious, moral or ethical convictions without discrimination or penalty.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Parents should have the right to consent to medical treatment for their children, including mental health treatment, drug treatment, and treatment involving pregnancy, contraceptives and abortion.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Pending legislation should be enacted that would require parental consent to transport girls across state lines for abortions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
